carpet.rule.alwaysSweepAttack.desc: Always triggers a sweep attack when an attack with a sword in the main hand succeeds, ignoring attack cooldown, critical-hit checks, sprinting, grounded state, and movement speed limits
carpet.rule.customBlockingKnockbackStren: Custom knockback strength applied to the attacker after an item blocks a melee attack
carpet.rule.evokerNeverSummonVex.desc: Evokers never attempt to summon vexes: they never start the summoning spell (no cast warm-up or prepare sound); other spells such as evoker fangs are unaffected
carpet.rule.witchNeverUseHarmingPotion.d: Witches never attempt to use potions of harming: when vanilla would choose a harming potion they skip the throw entirely; other potion choices are unaffected
